hypotheses.claim: Routine Googlebot crawling repeats the behaviour of the testing tools
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Verified organic request records, trigger attribution and code matched to the deployment.

hypotheses.claim: Entity consistency increases AI citation likelihood
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Fixed question set, saved responses and citations, baseline and documented intervention with repeated measurements.

hypotheses.claim: Query language outweighs IP geography, which outweighs the gl parameter
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Repeated controlled language, egress and parameter comparisons with environment metadata.

hypotheses.claim: The round beacon timestamp was caused by a frozen renderer clock
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Beacon code, complete request records, repeat test and renderer diagnostics.

hypotheses.claim: The captcha and NavBoost share the same underlying behaviour machinery
hypotheses.needed_evidence: Authoritative architecture evidence; a captcha alone does not identify the ranking system.

research_connections.rationale: Machine access can be observed separately from accurate representation.
Fetch evidence is one prerequisite for studying source selection; it does not explain selection.
Compare the site-specific account with official search guidance without treating the guidance as validation of the account.
